niche_preference_profile: This user prefers interfaces that feel polished, warm, and easy to scan, with clear hierarchy, visible structure, and enough content on screen to feel complete. They like bright or light themes, strong but not cluttered emphasis, concise copy, obvious primary actions, and direct controls that are easy to understand. They generally reject empty, prototype-like, overly dark, or overly minimal screens.

criteria.description: Strong, easy-to-read hierarchy with a dominant title, clear focal point, and well-separated sections or cards.
Short, direct, and non-verbose labels, headlines, and explanatory text.
Multiple clearly separated sections or grouped blocks that make the screen feel organized and scannable.
Screens that show enough settings, entries, or context to feel complete rather than sparse or placeholder-like.
Obvious, highly visible primary CTAs and direct inline controls that make the next action unmistakable.
Light, airy, high-contrast, or brighter color treatments rather than dark, heavy, muted, or washed-out styling.
A finished, modern, app-like interface that feels refined rather than prototype-like or unfinished.
Warm, reassuring, step-by-step experiences with clear progress cues and approachable conversational tone.
